I have resolved the issue according to the requirements specified in `summary.txt`.

### Root Cause
In [`BaseSecantSolver.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_50_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/analysis/solvers/BaseSecantSolver.java#L185-L191), the `REGULA_FALSI` method case included an artificial heuristic interval adjustment (`if (x == x1)` modifying `x0` and re-evaluating `f0`). This violated the standard Regula Falsi algorithm requirement and prevented `TooManyEvaluationsException` from being thrown when maximum evaluations were exhausted without achieving convergence.

### Solution
- Removed the artificial adjustment block under `case REGULA_FALSI:` in [`BaseSecantSolver.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_50_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/analysis/solvers/BaseSecantSolver.java).
- Verified that `org.apache.commons.math.analysis.solvers.RegulaFalsiSolverTest::testIssue631` passes and throws `TooManyEvaluationsException` as expected.
- Generated the focused patch file at [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_50_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
